split_procedure: A fixed, hand-authored synthetic corpus was assigned before evaluation: 36 development (60%), 12 validation (20%), and 12 locked-test (20%) records. Near-duplicate wording is kept within the same split where practical. This manifest freezes only the locked-test input and annotation files; any change requires a new version and new hashes.
source_notice: 60/60 records are fictional synthetic data. No real distributor messages or prices are represented.
